# README_B200_INFERENCE: uv environment for the multi-model collector on B200

Status: **resolved and installed on Linux (WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64, no Blackwell GPU); inference not yet verified on
B200.** Test results are in section 6. The v1 environment (`env/requirements-gpu-linux.txt`,
`env/setup_gpu_linux.sh`, torch 2.4.0+cu121, RTX 4090) is unchanged and remains the reference of the SD1.5 study.

## 1. Scope

This environment covers inference only:
- generators: SD1.5, SDXL base 1.0, SD3.5 Medium, FLUX.1-dev;
- the predicted clean latent x0 at each checkpoint, decoded with the model's VAE;
- scoring with ImageReward v1.0 and PickScore v1;
- the common prompt encoder: SD1.5 CLIP text pooler, float16[N,768], identical to v1 `apsp.data.prompts`;
- writing the bank: npy latents, PNG images, parquet tables.

It does not include RL controller training, PPO/DeepSpeed, GenEval or HPS.

## 2. Files (all in `env/b200/`)

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `pyproject.toml` | Virtual uv project: dependencies, CUDA wheel index, git pins, static metadata for CLIP and ImageReward, build constraint |
| `uv.lock` | Generated by `uv lock` (uv 0.11.17). Universal lock restricted to Linux x86_64 |
| `.python-version` | `3.11` |
| `models_b200.yaml` | HF commit SHAs of the 4 generators, ImageReward, the BERT tokenizer, PickScore and the CLIP-H processor, plus smoke sampling defaults |
| `scripts/check_gpu.py` | Node check: versions, sm_100 kernels in the build, fp16/bf16 numerics, SDPA backends, VRAM pattern test, collector imports |
| `scripts/run_shard.py` | One inference shard: x0 at checkpoints, VAE decode, IR + PickScore, npy/PNG/parquet, manifest with sha256 |
| `scripts/smoke_b200.sh` | First run on the node: GPU check, then a 4-prompt × 4-seed shard per generator |

## 3. Choices and pins

| Item | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Python | 3.11 (`requires-python ==3.11.*`) | Old setup.py builds (CLIP, ImageReward, fairscale) work there; all wheels exist |
| torch / torchvision | **2.9.1+cu128 / 0.24.1+cu128** from `https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128` (index `pytorch-cu128`, `explicit = true`, used only for torch and torchvision) | Blackwell (sm_100) needs CUDA ≥ 12.8 builds. cu128 wheels need an NVIDIA driver ≥ 570. torch 2.4/cu121 is not a B200 target |
| triton | 3.5.1 (dependency of torch) | — |
| diffusers | 0.39.0 | Has `StableDiffusion3Pipeline` (SD3.5 Medium MMDiT-X) and `FluxPipeline`. The newest release that still works with huggingface-hub < 1.0, which transformers 4.57 requires |
| transformers / tokenizers | **4.57.6** / 0.22.2 (`>=4.57,<5`) | ImageReward's BLIP (`med.py`) imports `transformers.file_utils` and `modeling_utils` helpers from the 4.x API. transformers 5 is not used so that third-party code stays unpatched |
| accelerate / huggingface-hub / safetensors | 1.15.0 / 0.36.2 / 0.8.0 | Resolved by uv |
| sentencepiece / protobuf | 0.2.2 / 5.29.6 | T5 tokenizer for SD3.5 and FLUX |
| ImageReward | git `THUDM/ImageReward@2ca71bac4ed86b922fe53ddaec3109fe94d45fd3` (1.5) | Same commit as v1 |
| CLIP | git `openai/CLIP@dcba3cb2e2827b402d2701e7e1c7d9fed8a20ef1` | Same commit as v1 |
| timm / fairscale / datasets | 1.0.30 / 0.4.13 / 5.0.1 | ImageReward imports them (`datasets` through `ImageReward/__init__` → ReFL) |
| numpy / pandas / pyarrow / pillow | 2.2.6 / 2.3.3 / 26.0.0 / 11.3.0 | apsp ran on numpy 1.26 / pandas 2.2 / pillow 11.1: kept on pandas 2 and pillow 11 |
| xformers / flash-attn | not installed | The collector uses torch SDPA (diffusers default) |

How CLIP and ImageReward are reproduced without manual pip steps (this replaces the v1 `--no-deps --no-build-isolation` installs):
- **Floating CLIP dependency removed.** `setup.py` of ImageReward requires `clip @ https://github.com/openai/CLIP/archive/refs/heads/main.zip`, which floats. `[[tool.uv.dependency-metadata]]` declares the `install_requires` of both packages exactly as written at the pinned commits, except that this floating URL becomes `clip`. `[tool.uv.sources]` then resolves `clip` to the pinned CLIP commit.
- **Build constraint.** Both `setup.py` files import `pkg_resources`, so `build-constraint-dependencies = ["setuptools==69.5.1"]` (the v1 version) constrains every isolated build.
- **Locale.** ImageReward's `setup.py` reads its README with the locale codec. Python 3.11 in a C/POSIX locale switches to UTF-8 automatically. The scripts also export `PYTHONUTF8=1`.

ImageReward's checks are kept unchanged: `apsp.gpu.scoring.ImageRewardScorer`, which is the v1 code.
- The BERT tokenizer is pinned to `google-bert/bert-base-uncased@86b5e0934494bd15c9632b12f734a8a67f723594` (only `vocab.txt`, `tokenizer_config.json` and `config.json`) and checked after construction.
- Missing checkpoint keys raise an error. The checkpoint revision is `THUDM/ImageReward@5736be03b2652728fb87788c9797b0570450ab72`.
- PickScore follows the same rule: `AutoModel.from_pretrained(..., output_loading_info=True)`, and a missing key raises an error.

## 4. Install

```bash
# uv >= 0.11 (tested with 0.11.17). On the cluster: Linux x86_64, NVIDIA driver >= 570.
git clone https://github.com/NguyenNgocMinh30012005/DMRL.git && cd DMRL && git checkout b200/inference-env
cd env/b200
uv lock --check            # pyproject and uv.lock agree
uv sync --locked           # creates env/b200/.venv exactly from uv.lock (never re-resolves)
# venv elsewhere (e.g. node-local disk): UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/scratch/$USER/apsp-b200 uv sync --locked
```
Set `HF_HOME` to a large shared disk before downloading models (about 60 GB for the 4 generators and scorers).

SD3.5 Medium and FLUX.1-dev are gated. Each person accepts the licence on Hugging Face and logs in on the node (`uv run hf auth login`, or `HF_TOKEN` in the job environment). Never put a token in the repo or the bank.

## 5. Run

```bash
cd env/b200
export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 PYTHONUTF8=1 HF_HOME=/shared/hf
# 1) node check (exit 0 = pass; requires sm_100 by default)
uv run --locked python scripts/check_gpu.py --out gpu_check.json --vram-gb 40
# 2) first smoke: GPU check + 4 prompts x 4 seeds per generator, preview PNGs kept
bash scripts/smoke_b200.sh /scratch/$USER/b200_smoke
# 3) one real shard (one GPU per process, e.g. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=i for shard i)
uv run --locked python scripts/run_shard.py --model sdxl --prompts /data/prompt_pool.parquet --split val \
    --shard-index 0 --num-shards 64 --banks 0 1 --k 8 --out /data/collect
```

`run_shard.py`:
- It resumes per prompt-bank (`parts/`) and rebuilds the parquet tables and `manifest.json` at the end of each run.
- Steps, guidance, resolution, dtype and checkpoints default to the values in `models_b200.yaml`. These are **model-card defaults for smoke runs; the study values must be fixed by research.**
- Checkpoints default to every steps/8 steps; set them with `--checkpoints 4,8,...`.
